profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, trading on the NYSE under the ticker IBM. The company reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000051143. Its website for the products covered here focuses on IBM OpenPages, which the company describes as a highly scalable, AI-powered, unified GRC platform designed to help organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in a single integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises.

IBM's tracked AI products span governance, risk, and enterprise AI. IBM OpenPages with Watson is presented as a full governance, risk, and compliance platform incorporating AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance covers AI lifecycle governance including model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is described as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic and includes capabilities for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

The held facts record 260 instances of legal exposure associated with New York but list no specific litigation cases. No MCP server entry is recorded in the held facts, though the company's own site references an OpenPages MCP Server capability for enabling AI agents to interact with GRC objects.
